governance.title: Chairperson — Student Volunteer Army
governance.description: Founder and former Chief Executive of the SVA, Sam now serves on its board — supporting the national volunteering organisation he started after the Christchurch earthquakes.

governance.title: Director — Isaac Theatre Royal
governance.description: Board member of Christchurch's historic Isaac Theatre Royal, one of New Zealand's finest heritage theatres.

governance.title: Chairperson — Metro Media Group
governance.description: Chair of the media company behind Auckland's Metro magazine, guiding the iconic title through new ownership and a refreshed editorial model.

governance.title: Director — Consult Recruitment
governance.description: Director of Consult Recruitment, an Auckland accounting, finance and business-support recruitment agency within the STILL family of companies.

governance.title: Chair — DDMMYY
governance.description: Chair of DDMMYY, the design and brand studio acquired by STILL as part of its programme of backing New Zealand creative companies.

governance.title: Chair — No More Boring
governance.description: Creative venture chaired by Sam within the STILL portfolio. Description and dates to be confirmed by Sam's team.

governance.title: Chartered Member — Institute of Directors NZ
governance.description: Chartered Member of the Institute of Directors in New Zealand, and winner of the IoD's 2022 Auckland Emerging Director Award.

governance.title: Adjunct Fellow — University of Canterbury
governance.meta: School of Leadership and Education · Current
governance.description: Adjunct Fellow recognising Sam's contribution to leadership education and the university where the Student Volunteer Army began.

governance.title: Emerging Leaders Co-Chair — Australia New Zealand Leadership Forum
governance.description: Inaugural co-chair of the Forum's Emerging Leaders programme, connecting the next generation of trans-Tasman business and civic leaders.

governance.title: Elected Member — Christchurch City Council Community Board
governance.description: Elected to a local community board as a university student, helping the city navigate planning, infrastructure and disaster-recovery decisions through the earthquake years.

governance.title: Advisory Trustee — Pacific Development and Conservation Trust
governance.description: Advisory trustee of the government-established trust funding development and conservation projects across the South Pacific.

governance.title: Trustee — Ministry of Awesome
governance.description: Founding-era trustee of the Christchurch startup hub that connects new ideas with the people, funding and support to make them real.

governance.title: Trustee — Plunket Foundation
governance.description: Trustee of the philanthropic foundation building an endowment to help New Zealand communities grow great kids.

governance.title: Director — International Association for Volunteer Effort
governance.description: Former director of the global network championing volunteering, based in Washington, DC.

governance.title: Member — Westpac Sustainability Panel
governance.description: Former member of Westpac New Zealand's external sustainability advisory panel.

governance.title: Director — Prince's Trust New Zealand
governance.description: Former director of the New Zealand arm of the Prince's Trust, supporting young people into education, training and enterprise.

projects.title: Student Volunteer Army
projects.description: Founded after the Christchurch earthquakes, the SVA mobilised 11,000 students through social media and grew into a national volunteering organisation — operating in 258 secondary schools and six universities, with programmes in Tasmania and South Australia and a partnership with IHC recognising volunteers with intellectual disabilities. Sam served as Chief Executive until 2023 and remains on the board.

projects.title: Paererewā — The 1,000-Year Bench Project
projects.description: A charitable project creating 1,000 places to sit and reflect across Aotearoa, each designed to endure for 1,000 years. Launched at the Aotearoa Art Fair in 2025 in partnership with Hideaki Fukutake and Derek Handley's Aera Foundation.

projects.title: STILL & the STILL 100
projects.description: Sam leads projects at STILL, the family office founded by Hideaki Fukutake that backs long-term ventures amplifying people, nature, arts and culture in New Zealand — including a programme of acquiring and growing 100 Kiwi companies.

projects.title: SVA COVID-19 Response
projects.description: During the COVID-19 lockdowns the SVA built a national grocery delivery service with New World, mobilising volunteers across the country to shop for older and vulnerable New Zealanders — one of more than 20 domestic disaster responses Sam led as Chief Executive.

projects.title: SVA in Schools & the Service Award
projects.description: The SVA's education programmes teach volunteering from primary to tertiary level — over 25,000 primary students have taken part in SVA Kids — while the SVA Service Award gives secondary students a nationally recognised record of their volunteer hours.

projects.title: WeVisit & Mycare
projects.description: A social enterprise matching young visitors with older New Zealanders living alone, founded with Dr Tyler Brummer to combat loneliness. WeVisit joined forces with home-care platform Mycare in 2017, where Sam became Head of Community Innovation.

projects.title: Tōhoku Earthquake Response
projects.description: Sam's first international deployment — supporting volunteer coordination after the Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami, and testing the SVA model beyond New Zealand.

projects.title: Cyclone Pam & Nepal Earthquake Responses
projects.description: Back-to-back disaster deployments focused on volunteer mobilisation and community resilience in two very different contexts.

projects.title: Global Youth Leadership Advocacy
projects.description: Programme design, advisory work and keynotes that have influenced school students, boardrooms and politicians across three continents.
